claim_scope: the DRIVE SWAP at 230M on four bridges trained in process per seed (G1's goal+constant pair on G1's rng stream by G6's recipe, the goal bridge discarded; GF's focus+constant pair on a freshly re-seeded stream by GF's recipe): the chain's goal line through G6's latent prefix and the focus packet through the bus, on GF-3r's path, with G1's constant bridge as the baseline drive and the mix anchor and GF's constant bridge held beside it as the identity cell; 3 bridge seed(s) x 10 eval chains x 6 arms. What is measured is whether the prefix door's loss in GF-3r belonged to the BRIDGE or to the PATH; the lean ladder is a second question and is a reading only if the door stands. Nothing here cites GS.

decision_rules.composes: pooled success_rate(arm) >= success_rate(prefix-only) - 0.1 AND the mix moves toward the focus: tool_mix[focus](arm) - tool_mix[focus](prefix-only) >= 0.15 OR first_tick_mix[focus](arm) - first_tick_mix[focus](prefix-only) >= 0.15 (review amendment before the run: share alone is blind when the focus is already the habitual tool -- GF-3's 27B LOOK arm moved first tick 0.8->1.0 at share 0.63->0.64)
decision_rules.identity_cell_reproduces: per seed, arm prefix-only-gf against GF-3r's committed artifact (arm prefix-only, same seed): at least (chains - 1) chains with an IDENTICAL tool list and a success rate within 0.1; `reproduces` requires every seed to clear both. A missing artifact records null and `reproduces` is then not established
decision_rules.order: (iv) precondition first, on the ALL-SEED pooled prefix-only success; then (v) breakdown, flagged per seed; then (i)/(ii)/(iii) on the pooled episodes of the DECIDING (non-breakdown) seeds, with breakdown seeds reported beside them
decision_rules.q1_a_loss_was_the_bridge: pooled success_rate(prefix-only, the G1 constant) >= 0.8 AND identity_cell.reproduces — the loss was the BRIDGE: the prefix door is drive-dependent, confirmed on one path; Q2 is taken
decision_rules.q1_b_loss_was_the_path: pooled success_rate(prefix-only, the G1 constant) < 0.8 — the loss was the PATH: GF-3r's reading (iv) was a harness effect and the prefix door is NOT shown to be drive-dependent; Q2 is computed but NOT taken (there is no valid baseline on this path)
decision_rules.q1_c_identity_cell_broke: identity_cell.reproduces is false — arm prefix-only-gf does not reproduce GF-3r's own prefix-only within one episode per seed; determinism broke. This takes precedence as a FLAG: `provisional` is set on whatever else is read, and when the pooled baseline would otherwise satisfy (a) the reading IS (c)
decision_rules.q1_order: GF-3r-g1 asks two questions in order. Q1 decides whether the prefix door stands at all on this path; the ladder above is Q2 and is a READING only under Q1 (a). Q1 (c) is a flag on whatever else is read, never a replacement for it
decision_rules.q2_taken: the ladder is a reading only under Q1 (a); otherwise it is computed, recorded and printed with q2_taken false, and it is NOT a reading
decision_rules.reading_ladder: (i) both lean arms compose AND at least one grip arm overrides; (ii) both lean arms compose AND no grip arm overrides; (iii) neither lean arm composes; a split (exactly one lean arm composes) is reported as 'mixed' rather than forced into one of the three, because the registration's (i)-(iii) all speak of the lean arms in the plural. A FAILED PRECONDITION takes precedence over the ladder — the registration calls (iv) the finding — and the ladder's own outcome is recorded beside it as `ladder_key`, never dropped
decision_rules.source: the registration states readings (i)-(v) in prose; these thresholds are THIS HARNESS's operationalization of that prose and are recorded and printed rather than hidden

injection_placement.bank_offsets: 0 on the last prefill position, then 1, 2, ... per generated token, clamped at delta_positions-1 = 15; __enter__ resets the counter, so every generate call starts at 0
injection_placement.decode_steps: each KV-cached step takes start=0 over its single new position, so every generated token is injected
injection_placement.effect_of_prefix_length: P shifts the ABSOLUTE index of the injection point by exactly P and changes nothing else: not the relative placement (always the last prefill position), not the bank-offset schedule, not the count of injected positions
injection_placement.identical_across_arms: the six arms differ only in the payload; the prefix is one cached tensor per chain, reused by every arm, so P is a property of the chain alone and the placement is identical across arms by construction

injection_placement.prefill_position_meaning: the LAST token of the rendered chat prompt (the generation-prompt tail); positions 0..P-1 (the entire goal prefix) and P..P+L-2 are NOT injected
injection_placement.prefix_text_rule: g6_splitdoor.installed_goal_line(chain['item']) — G6's prefix verbatim, embedded through model.get_input_embeddings(); note GF-3 at 27B appended '\n\n' to the goal line and G6 did not, and the registration pins G6's mechanism

protocol.drive_note: FOUR bridges per seed on TWO rng streams. Stream 1 is G1's: g6_splitdoor.run_g6's block verbatim, goal bridge first (trained only to place the rng, then discarded) and constant bridge second. The seeding is then re-run exactly as GF-3r runs it and stream 2 is GF's: gf2b_mix's block, focus bridge first and constant bridge second — so BOTH pairs see the stream their own registered recipe saw, and arm prefix-only-gf is GF-3r's own prefix-only arm. The lean and grip arms mix GF's focus packet against G1's constant packet; the two were not trained as a pair, which is recorded, not designed around.
protocol.held_out_position_rule: gf_focus.held_out_position — HELD_OUT[chain index % 2], GF's parity: position 8 for an even chain index, 9 for an odd one
protocol.note: six arms x the eval chains, budget 8, every episode carrying the chain's goal line in the latent prefix and a packet on the bus; prefix-only takes the CONSTANT packet (the drive) and is both the composition baseline and the prefix door's own measurement under GF's constant bridge. The bridge pair is GF's pair: gf2b_mix's training block and per-seed rng order copied VERBATIM (focus bridge first, constant bridge second, one rng stream), so the reproduction is deterministic and these are the same bridges; the training block lives inside run_gf2b's body as closures and could not be imported. The lean arms mix in GF-2b's PAYLOAD locus at alpha 0.25 and the grip arms at alpha 1.0; the injection renormalizes whatever delta it is handed and rescales it by the position's own residual norm, so alpha turns the packet's DIRECTION and never its magnitude, and the delivered dose is the trained dose in every arm. The prefix door is G6's and stays ZERO-SHOT: nothing trains against prefix-formatted inputs. Congruence is NOT pre-labelled — both tools are instrumental to the errand and which focus helps is the question. Nothing here cites GS.

A missing artifact records null and `reproduces` is then not established
rules.order: (iv) precondition first, on the ALL-SEED pooled prefix-only success; then (v) breakdown, flagged per seed; then (i)/(ii)/(iii) on the pooled episodes of the DECIDING (non-breakdown) seeds, with breakdown seeds reported beside them
rules.q1_a_loss_was_the_bridge: pooled success_rate(prefix-only, the G1 constant) >= 0.8 AND identity_cell.reproduces — the loss was the BRIDGE: the prefix door is drive-dependent, confirmed on one path; Q2 is taken
rules.q1_b_loss_was_the_path: pooled success_rate(prefix-only, the G1 constant) < 0.8 — the loss was the PATH: GF-3r's reading (iv) was a harness effect and the prefix door is NOT shown to be drive-dependent; Q2 is computed but NOT taken (there is no valid baseline on this path)
rules.q1_c_identity_cell_broke: identity_cell.reproduces is false — arm prefix-only-gf does not reproduce GF-3r's own prefix-only within one episode per seed; determinism broke. This takes precedence as a FLAG: `provisional` is set on whatever else is read, and when the pooled baseline would otherwise satisfy (a) the reading IS (c)
rules.q1_order: GF-3r-g1 asks two questions in order. Q1 decides whether the prefix door stands at all on this path; the ladder above is Q2 and is a READING only under Q1 (a). Q1 (c) is a flag on whatever else is read, never a replacement for it
rules.q2_taken: the ladder is a reading only under Q1 (a); otherwise it is computed, recorded and printed with q2_taken false, and it is NOT a reading
rules.reading_ladder: (i) both lean arms compose AND at least one grip arm overrides; (ii) both lean arms compose AND no grip arm overrides; (iii) neither lean arm composes; a split (exactly one lean arm composes) is reported as 'mixed' rather than forced into one of the three, because the registration's (i)-(iii) all speak of the lean arms in the plural. A FAILED PRECONDITION takes precedence over the ladder — the registration calls (iv) the finding — and the ladder's own outcome is recorded beside it as `ladder_key`, never dropped
rules.source: the registration states readings (i)-(v) in prose; these thresholds are THIS HARNESS's operationalization of that prose and are recorded and printed rather than hidden
